# MenuItem

One action in a `Menu`: `onClick` runs it, `href` makes it a link, `shortcut` shows its keys and `tone="destructive"` marks an action that cannot be undone.

```tsx
import { MenuItem } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/menu/menu";
```

## Example

```tsx
<MenuItem onClick={edit} shortcut={["mod", "e"]}>Edit</MenuItem>
<MenuItem href="/recipes/1/print">Print</MenuItem>
<MenuItem tone="destructive" onClick={remove}>Delete</MenuItem>
```

## Use instead when

- Use `MenuCheckboxItem` instead for an on/off setting, and `MenuRadioItem` for one choice of several.

## Props

Type: `MenuItemProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The item's text, or text with an icon. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Shown, but cannot be chosen. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Makes the item a link: an internal path goes through `OuroProvider`'s router link, an absolute URL is a plain `<a>`. The menu closes when it is followed. |
| `onClick` | `((event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => void)` |  | Runs when the item is chosen, by click, tap or Enter. The menu then closes. |
| `shortcut` | `MenuShortcut` |  | The item's keyboard shortcut, as `Kbd` shows it: `["mod", "e"]` is ⌘E on Apple platforms and Ctrl+E elsewhere. It only shows the keys; bind them in your app. |
| `tone` | `"destructive"` |  | `"destructive"` for an action that deletes or cannot be undone. |

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `asChild`: Not a prop. For a link, pass `href`: `<MenuItem href="/recipes/1">`.
- `checked`: Not a prop. A checkable item is a `MenuCheckboxItem`: `<MenuCheckboxItem checked={pinned} onCheckedChange={setPinned}>`.
- `onSelect`: Not a prop. The handler is `onClick`: `<MenuItem onClick={edit}>`. (A `Command` item is the one that takes `onSelect`.)
- `variant`: Not a prop. A menu item takes `tone`: `<MenuItem tone="destructive">`.

## Types

### `MenuShortcut`

Keys for a shortcut, as `Kbd` takes them: `["mod", "e"]` shows ⌘E on Apple platforms and Ctrl+E elsewhere.

```ts
type MenuShortcut = readonly string[] | (string & { 'Use an array: shortcut={["mod", "k"]}': never });
```
